description:
LANDED 2e0bb2706 on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. Cold review with
prototype (BLOCK on the element-precision cut; re-cut as demand-through-
forwarding and approved), adversarial refutation (LAND WITH FIXES, folded).

THE CHANGE: an activation key names what its own return depends on, forwarding
included. jobs/keying.rs `derive_input_demand` walks the FORWARDING cone of a
function (a direct-call tail argument whose value IS a clause parameter; a
protocol callback forwards every input to every implementation, a static
over-approximation of a runtime dispatch), every consulted fact ledgered
(StaticCallees, EntryDispatch, LoweredBody, ProtocolDispatch, FunctionDefined,
ModuleDefined -- in the same rung order as semantic::resolve_protocol_call so
no arm-less co-output is ever a first wait), and computes a Kleene least
fixpoint from the cone's LOCAL masks -- never another function's published
demand, so no wait cycle. The fact is FactKey::InputDemand { local_dispatch,
forwarded_dispatch } (DispatchMask, DeriveDispatchMask, DispatchMaskMap,
define_dispatch_mask, the dispatch_mask.derived event: renamed, no dual
names, northstar.html included). erase_transported_closure_identities reads
the LOCAL half (the fz-6gb brand coupling; gated by the k1 law); the key
collapse and the evidence collapse read the FORWARDED half.
convergence_class_at gained keep_elements: a demanded list keeps its element
at every depth, freight collapses as before.

WHAT IT PROVED: three doors, red at accb5cfbe, green here:
with_index_users_key_apart_by_element.fz (spec/violation `strings/1 ([binary]
| [int])` -> [1, 1] / [0, 1]); the two-user Enum.reduce/3 pair absorbed from
fz-kdt.122, both statement orders, oracle-exact ([202, 201] / ["b!", "a!"]:
x + 200 because Elixir inspects [12, 11] as a charlist);
with_index_users_keep_nested_list_elements.fz (artifact/incomplete-semantic-
plan panic at artifact.rs:154 -> [[1], [2]] / [["s"], ["t"]]). Drive gate
ONE_ACTIVATION_KEYING_LAWS: freight loop(n, junk) at two junk types keys ONE
activation, split3/5 ONE, split4/6 ONE, partition/4 ONE at 17 executables
(derived, not re-blessed), k1 fwd/2 ONE (flipping the erase to
forwarded_dispatch prints `fwd/2 keys 2 activations, the law says 1`).
reduce_step/3 keys [list(int), {:cont, list(a1_1_e)}, a2] beside
[list(binary), ...]: slot 1's payload and slot 2 stay free.
compiler2_no_ascent_rung_sits_on_a_freight_slot_of_a_recursive_key: 0 rungs
on freight slots over 8 recursive-key readings (a boundary that holds by
construction against unconditional element keying; it does NOT detect a
collapse reading the wrong half -- six other tests do, stated on the gate).

MEASURED (597 fixtures, 469 dumps, against accb5cfbe; builder and refuter
independently): interp 0 movers, run 0 movers, canon 52 movers (9 execs up,
1 down: enum_predicate_search 206 -> 166, 42 equal); executables 5297 ->
5282; FIFO/LIFO 2 -> 1 mover (dead_closure_capture_empty_list alone) and the
executable count schedule-INDEPENDENT (5297/5298 -> 5282/5282). Rung census
53/15 -> 58/16: six added, all on DEMANDED slots and all code-different ON
THE RUNG SLOT (Map.to_list/4 s3 + Map.reverse/2 s0, Range.slice_from/5 s4 +
Range.reverse/2 s0, Kernel.dbg/1 + fz_dbg_value/1 non-recursive), one retired
(Range.reduce/5 s3). Job work on enum_take_drop_split: spans 2379 -> 2419,
DeriveInputDemand 200 -> 256 (base ran it exactly 2x per function; head is
long-tailed, max 17 -- the cone walk restarts on every re-entry, bounded by
cone depth), DeriveCallGraphComponent 134 -> 126, DeriveFunctionContract 111
-> 83; rebased completions 10 -> 77 / 2 -> 22 / 19 -> 127 on the three lenses
(InputDemand is a fact that MOVES; uncaused stays empty). Wall: enum_
predicate_search 316 -> 219 ms, 00277 347 -> 298, 00420 499 -> 513; corpus
wall noise-dominated. Censuses edited DOWN, each a cure: blind-escape 48 ->
29 with every call-edge reading gone; seat 21 sites/27 -> 17/29; surface-
membership enum_predicate_search arms:6 1 -> 0; BLIND_ESCAPE_PAIRS_UNDER_
SEED_SIX folded into ARRIVAL_KEPT (seed 6 no longer differs); capture-
surfaces gate re-aimed at enum_take_drop_split (16 multi-member wrappers).
With proto120 stacked: enum_map_family, enum_tier0, fz_f98_map_reduce byte-
equal to expected.

FOLDED FROM REFUTATION: semantic-fixpoint.md's pre-183 law restated at the
freight/demanded boundary; northstar.html's six DispatchMask names; the rung
gate and the corpus census are two relations (per-slot 162/16 vs whole-key
58/16) and say so; six forward ticket pointers in .agent/docs replaced by
the facts; the ModuleDefined rung before ProtocolDispatch.

RESIDUES, EACH OWNED: the evidence-collapse read at World of
forwarded_dispatch is UNGATED (flipping it to local_dispatch moves nothing
on 597 fixtures) -- see fz-kdt.196's comment; same-key duplicate executables
67 -> 73 corpus-wide (00531, 00127 newly affected): fz-kdt.182's class,
enlarged by six; fz-kdt.131 loses its only reproducer (retired as a cure,
not hidden); fz-kdt.179's allowance 17/29; fz-kdt.199 unblocked (g0n.fz);
fz-kdt.200: a forwarded Whole has no collapse (344 rows / 174 functions);
fz-kdt.120 unblocked. Pre-existing, not this commit's: self-nesting
accumulator hangs at base (fz-kdt.177's class); the runtime-source excerpt
gutter moves with the fixture's own length (fz-kdt.19); 00424 panics at
artifact.rs:155 (fz-kdt.149); metadata_macro_rejects_duplicate_keys red in
--release (fz-kdt.191).

GATE: Coordinator gate on the folded commit (marker COORD-GATE-1788437329): fmt clean, zero build warnings, clippy clean, lib 1618 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored, fixture matrix single-threaded 497 passed / 0 failed / 9 ignored (twelve new trials: the four new fixtures on three doors), known-red set unchanged.

comments.text: RESEARCH DONE (2026-09-03, prototype + corpus; report + proto183.diff in the coordinator's scratchpad, being cold-reviewed). THE MECHANISM: Types::convergence_class_at (types/mod.rs:780-796) turns a pure list slot into list(address_var) and a pure callable into address_var on the RECURSIVE key branch (World::canonical_activation_key :1884 -> convergence_collapse :845 -> Ignore arm :1016-1032) -- fz-y6w bounded specialization as documented ("list(int) and list(any) share one recursive key"). reduce_cont/3 escapes only because its mask is ListShape(Ignore) and the descent reaches the element; nest the element one list deeper and it collapses too. THE DEFECT IS LIVE AT HEAD, not only under 120: repro183.fz (dbg(Enum.with_index([["a"], ["b"]], fn (x, _i) -> M.strings(x) end)) beside an independent int with_index) fails with error[spec/violation]: strings/1 ... ([binary] | [int]) on interp, run AND build; delete the neighbour and it prints [1, 1]. Also proven at HEAD: swapping two independent statements flips reduce_step/3's published return FACT (fz-kdt.190). POPULATION: 146 blind-shared activations (free var in key AND >=2 publishers with different evidence) over 30 functions / 46 fixtures; Enum.reduce_while/3 32, List.reduce_cont/3 20, ... CANDIDATES measured: keep the callable in the key -> 7 fixtures hit the multi-target-closure arg-floor (fz-kdt.189, blocked behind runtime demand); per-row/per-publisher return correlation -> quicksort prints [3] (rows are the caller's own ASCENT HISTORY as well as publishers; the cross-row join IS the fixpoint); stop the coalesce blend -> sound but does not cure (fz-kdt.188). RECOMMENDED E': convergence_class_at keeps the list ELEMENT (18 lines): repro green on three doors, corpus FIFO/LIFO canon movers 2 -> 0 (dead_closure AND 00277 byte-identical), enum_predicate_search's blind-escape census empties, blind-shared 146 -> 78; cost executables 5297 -> 5383 (+1.6%) and the fz-y6w quicksort frontier bound moves (partition/4 1 -> 4; convergence still identical on every schedule) -- the bound must be RE-DERIVED, not re-pinned, which is the cold review's first question. With fz-kdt.120's prototype on top: enum_map_family GREEN, enum_tier0 + fz_f98_map_reduce oracle-exact. Gate 2 as written ("no free type variable") is not met by E' -- the callable slot stays a2 (fz-kdt.189); restate to the list and accumulator positions.

RESEARCH DONE, RULE PROTOTYPED (2026-09-03, proto183r.diff in the coordinator's scratchpad, being cold-reviewed). demand(f,i) = local(f,i) ⊔ ⨆{demand(g,j) : f forwards i to g@j} over the DispatchDemand lattice; forwarded = a direct-call tail arg equal to a clause param (projections/constructions/closure calls/captures are opaque); protocol callbacks forward to every implementation (FactKey::ProtocolDispatch); one job walks the forwarding cone and runs the Kleene least fixpoint; convergence_class_at keeps the element only where demand arrives (keep_elements). MEASURED (base 8de517a28): repro183 [1, 1]/[0, 1] and fz-kdt.122's oracle [12, 11]/["b!", "a!"] on three doors in both orders; partition/4 stays ONE activation (17 execs), freight loop(n, junk) ONE, split3/4 ONE; corpus interp/run 0 movers; executables 5297 -> 5282; FIFO/LIFO movers 2 -> 1 (0 with 120 stacked; LIFO execs = FIFO); blind-escape census 48 -> 29 (dispatch_list_head_separates and both enum_predicate_search entries retire); seat findings 73 -> 29; twins per site -> 1; 179's dynamic reproducer (enum_predicate_search arms:6) 1 -> 0; blind-shared 146 -> 136 (reduce_step/3 gone); wall clock 00420 1883 -> 1334 ms, enum_predicate_search 729 -> 366 ms; DeriveCallGraphComponent evaluations 134 -> 126; the four old-law keying tests and both quicksort gates UNMOVED (E' moved all of them); lib 1605/8/5 (2 re-pins, 5 cures, 1 vacuous gate), matrix 485/0/9; with 120 stacked enum_map_family/enum_tier0/fz_f98_map_reduce byte-equal to expected. RESIDUE: b1n/b2n/b4 (identical driver + seed, different lambda: only the a2 slot differs) still panic -- the minimal pair (kdt122 cured, b1n not) proves they are fz-kdt.165's callable axis, not this ticket's; rung census 53/15 -> 58/16: six rungs at accumulator slots genuinely forwarded into a dispatch (Map.to_list/4 + Map.reverse/2, Range.slice_from/5 + Range.reverse/2, dbg/1 + fz_dbg_value/1 on 00277) -- the rule's own law, one accumulator per function, not 2^k; the 'must not grow' acceptance is under review (restate to 'no rung on a freight slot' vs the pre-existing empty_list()/list(τ) non-convergence at demanded slots as its own item). Composition with 165: one cone walk, two demand axes (InputDemand { dispatch, identity }); erase_transported_closure_identities keys brand erasure off DispatchDemand::Ignore -- a dispatch-axis/callable-axis coupling to move to the identity axis.

Commit rewritten 2e0bb2706 -> 985406f7e (2026-09-03): CI ran `cargo test --workspace --doc` and the derive_input_demand doc comment in jobs/keying.rs carried an indented formula rustdoc treated as a doctest. It is a ```text block now, folded into fz-kdt.183; fz-kdt.198 replayed on top unchanged (tree diff between the two heads is that one doc line). The coordinator gate now runs the doctests.

title: A recursive activation key keeps a list element wherever demand reaches it -- through forwarding, not everywhere -- so one Enum.reduce/3 user cannot publish another user's return
